reviews.x: I have really enjoyed these products. They blend well together. They are thick, but not cakey.

reviews.t: 6 sticks, each with their own blender brush
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:9d6b73448b9c4669051332c7b4e0f4e9]] I was actually shopping for another cream eyeshadow stick by Julep that I really liked and found these instead with a blender BRUSH instead of a foam pad. I loved the one I had of the other brand, but the sponge blender kind of burned when I used it. It was just too rough for the eye area (mine, anyway).  At first I thought this set was just one eyeshadow stick and I was trying to figure out how to choose which color or purple I wanted. Then I saw tha
I received them in perfect condition and the contents were not dried out. Glides on smoothly and the sheerness is not overly intense, perfect for everyday use.

These really didnt work well for me.  They pull on my eyelids rather than gliding gently.  Also they are too light and do not blend.  The pictures show deep colors and I was just not able to achieve those deep colors or blend the colors together.  The formula is supposed to be waterproof and long lasting but these had worn off within hours.  I had a slight glitter effect left but that as it.  Perhaps on someone with a different skin tone they would be better.

I don't know if it was the batch that I received, but mine were hard to put on. Meaning they had to warm up with the skin before they could smoothly be applied. Before then, they were streaky and patchy.  I had hoped for a straight smooth application.  Other than that, I have no other complaints about the product. I really love the colors and they work fantastic with my green eyes.  I also love the brush at the bottom to help blend and smooth the eyes.

These are horrible!!! I have another set by the same brand and they are wonderful, goes on very smooth.... these not so much! They are very hard and almost gouging out my eye through my eye lid trying to get any color on! Wish I could send back, will more than likely end up throwing them out. Don't waste your money!!!!

I am perplexed by the rave reviews.  I gave these two stars because I did like the smoothness and thought I could use them as a primer. But on my fair skin they all looked like slight variations of a dull mauve, not vivid like the photo.
I guess you get what you pay for! Cheep  plastic covers, some of them were broken. Shades are so similar you don't see difference.
I enjoyed the all day long lasting color stays on . Most sweat off during the day but this stays on even until the night.
I love it. I wear it almost everyday and really it brightens my eyes. Got my money’s worth 👍🏼
Very nice! Will definitely buy again or recommend to someone. Great for stocking stuffer too!
Haven’t used all of the colors but the ones I did had good pigment and lasted for the day.

reviews.t: The color fell out when I opened it up...
reviews.x: I'm not crazy about these color sticks so far...sorry...

reviews.t: Quick, easy, blendable & at drugstore prices....gotta love it!!
reviews.x: I think we all have days where we're looking for something quick and easy when it comes to makeup.  Anything to get us out the door looking somewhat put together with the least amount of time involved is the goal.  If you're looking for a quick eyeshadow look that takes next to no time these are one answer.  Cream eyeshadow on one end and a brush on the other.  The brush is surprisingly usable, but since I've got older eyes (which means older skin that needs to be babied) I just use one of mine.

These eyeshadow sticks are alright. It says  purple in the title but to me they aren't really that much purple. A couple of them come out looking close to the exact same color. They are pretty and do shimmer I was just expecting different colors. They are easy to use but the brush that's on the end each stick seems to actually wipe the eyeshadow off my eyelids. You turn the part where the brush is with the cover on the brush to push up the eyeshadow but be careful when your turning it to bring t

reviews.t: Better precision than most eye shadow crayons
reviews.x: I've always liked the idea of eye shadow crayons- quick, easy and portable, but the reality is often disappointing- messy, easily smudged and imprecise. These eye shadow crayons actually work like I imagined they should. They go on easily and blend well but they don't create a smeary mess when you try to blend them. You can actually get a relatively precise result with them. They have a handy little brush on the one end which makes precise shaping and blending easy. I was pleasantly surprised th

These crayon eyeshadow sticks are interesting. It definitely takes a little getting used to, to work with them but once you get the hang of them they are a nice way to add color to your eye lids.  On one side they have the color crayons and on the other side you have a little brush that helps you work in the eye color. In this set you get 6 beautiful colors in the purple scheme which is great. The colors are pretty rich in pigment and they blend quite nicely. All in all I am quite happy with thi

The back of the box lists the ingredients be the manufacturer (in China). It also has the cruelty free bunny logo. (See photos)  The eyeshadow sticks are all in black tubes. They have the brand name “Luxaza” along with the name of the shade on the front written in the shade of

reviews.t: Not as creamy as the gold ones
reviews.x: I have switched from powder shadows to cream shadow sticks now that I am in my 60s and my skin is drier. I ordered this brand's gold set and loved them. They were very creamy and smooth. For some reason, this violet/purple set seems to be "drier," the colors are not as vivid, and they don't go on as smoothly. I still use them and like them, just giving them 4 stars instead of the 5 stars I gave the gold set. Good cream shadow sticks at a reasonable price point are hard to find, so I would still

I love the colors and names of these eyeshadow sticks. I am normally an eye shadow powder girl but wanted to give these sticks a try. They are very pretty and sheen. They blend out well too. However, they are not super pigmented so I use powder shadow and these mixed to create the look I really want to get. These apply super smooth and I haven't noticed a whole lot of creasing after a few hours of use like I have with other eye shadow creams. Overall, a really nice set of eye shadow sticks!

These eyeshadow sticks are very smooth and creamy. You have to slide it on a couple of times to get good pigmentation payoff however once you use the brush to blend it out the color slowly fades and leaves you with a sheer looking shadow. You will need to reapply a couple of times to have good coverage. Overall the colors and finish are cute however the execution could use some work. I recommend this if you want eyeshadow that is not too in your face or for tweens.

I was so looking forward to this product coming. It didn't take long for it to arrive. Unfortunately when I went to apply the eyeshadow it didn't glide on smoothly as advertised. The eyeshadow was so hard that I got a small cut on my eye from applying it. I could feel something hard in the eyeshadow. I wouldn't recommend buying this product at all. I did get a refund.

Bought this same palate in the neutral browns the previous month and loved them so much that I bought the purple bundle. These do Not glide on like the browns did. You literally have to pull your eye lid tight and press down hard and apply several time. I do not know if I got a very old batch and that's why they are like it. I like how long the color lasts.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the eyeshadow sticks easy to apply and long-lasting, staying on for hours or all day.
Several reviewers report the sticks are hard, drag or pull on the eyelids, and need warming up before they apply smoothly.
Some reviewers are disappointed that the shades are too light, similar, or not as vivid as the photos.
A few reviewers praise the smooth, non-cakey blending and good pigment.
Some reviewers mention quality issues like broken plastic covers or color falling out.
